name: 102 Processing
source:
--An unchanging everyday life.
Even though their days are seemingly uneventful, those days may be necessary to them...
Their story, told within just 1000 characters.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.mikadukimo.net/game08.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
——一成不变的日常。
看似平淡无奇的每一天，对他们而言，也许都是不可或缺的……
仅以一千字，讲述他们的故事。

[译自[url=http://www.mikadukimo.net/game08.html]官方网站[/url]]
